name: go-dev-toolkit
description: Reusable Go development toolkit bundling core skills for coding, code quality, LDAP, HUMA APIs, and MCP servers, plus the go-workspace MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Go coding, API, and MCP workflows
interface.longDescription: Bundles curated Go skills for general development and code quality, golangci-lint configuration, LDAP and Active Directory integration, HUMA v2 APIs, and MCP servers built with the official Go SDK, plus a go-workspace MCP server for local package discovery and pkg.go.dev lookups (versions, docs, symbols, importers, vulnerabilities).
defaultPrompt: Review and improve this Go codebase using the bundled Go skills
Build a HUMA API endpoint with strong validation and tests
Create a Go MCP server with typed tools and end-to-end tests
